structure.unit: Heat, Light, Power, Water and Other Utility Companies Generally
Powers of Commission in Relation to Service

law.catch_line: How reports shall be filed; reports open to public; rules and regulations

text.section: The information filed pursuant to § 56-249.3 shall be filed with the Commission in affidavit form within forty-five days following the close of the reference month.
All such information and reports filed pursuant to this section and § 56-249.3 shall be open to the public and available for inspection.
The Commission shall promulgate all rules and regulations necessary to implement this section and § 56-249.3.
